name: check_oncall_eligibility
description: check_oncall_eligibility: Verify whether an employee is eligible to register for on-call duty on a given unit. Blocks if the employee is currently on leave or is missing required certifications for the unit.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP048271

unit_code.description: The unit to check eligibility for. Format: digits+letter-letters. Example: 4B-ICU
